historical_reviews.v3_1: Requires the host to remain in a measured owner-defined idle state for the complete interval, not merely be reachable at two timestamps.

original_test_intent: Keep the approved SUT/OS in a defined idle state for a continuous 30 minutes with hibernation disabled, while proving no hang, blue screen or unexplained BMC/OS event occurs.
original_method: Record the starting power/workload/hibernate state, preserve logs, apply the approved reversible hibernate setting, confirm idle conditions, run a timestamped 30-minute dwell with health monitoring, then collect events and restore policy.
manual_activity: An engineer must approve the starting power state, idle definition, hibernate change and any log clearing; the agent can apply the approved reversible setting and automate the dwell/monitoring after confirmation.
required_inputs: Idle workload/service definition and start condition
Known-event policy and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Do not power-cycle an active host implicitly
Stop on hang, blue screen, device/storage/thermal anomaly or lost management
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Apply only the approved OS-specific hibernate control
Run the exact dwell and collect start/end plus anomaly telemetry
Restore policy and report without final verdict
engineer_actions: Define idle semantics and approve power/hibernate/log actions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient and unsafe: uptime/nproc through password-exposing SSH does not disable hibernate, establish idle, or verify BMC/OS criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the owner-approved OS-native hibernate controls and project health collectors around a monotonic 1800-second dwell; exact commands depend on the identified OS.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Thirty-minute idle, hibernate disable, log inspection and 15/30-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record a monotonic dwell interval with load, power-state, heartbeat and event evidence while proving no unintended sleep/hibernate transition, then restore the original policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds idle-state measurement and deterministic policy rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; full 30-minute stability remains required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Low load alone does not prove absence of hidden errors or a valid idle state.

project_override_considerations: A project may define Windows or Linux-specific idle counters, but must retain the full dwell, hibernate boundary, log review and policy restoration.
expected_evidence: Idle start/end monotonic timestamps and continuous reachability/load/power-state evidence
No hang/blue screen and stable device/storage/thermal health
Restored final policy/state and no hardware PASS claim

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source fields consistently define a 30-minute idle stability check with hibernate disabled; OS-specific controls are finite inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Once the OS, idle definition and reversible policy method are provided, the workflow is executable under approval.

review_improvement: Replaces two insecure reachability samples with a controlled power-policy lifecycle and complete 30-minute stability evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The dwell and health collection are automatable, but changing hibernate, powering on and potentially clearing logs alter system state and evidence. Those actions require package/user confirmation.
